purpose: Complementary read-only audit for persons_3 sidecars using the occurrences[] evidence schema, which was outside the prior fixed-WEB citation checker recognized arrays.

checks: 60 evidence/persons_3 JSON files with occurrences[] detected; current exact draft byte SHA compared
profile SHA checked as UTF-8 JSON ensure_ascii=false indent=2 trailing newline insertion-order serialization
each occurrence book inferred only from its linked current draft filename prefix (1CH_/2CH_)
chapter/verse keyed to pinned fixed WEB witness
stored occurrence text/fixedText compared byte-for-byte with exact fixed WEB verse text
stored text SHA compared against stored payload bytes
citationURL and witness version compared to pinned target row
method.noQuoteHandling: The explicit 2CH Adoniram no-profile exclusion record is separately reported and not converted to an occurrence or quote.
method.semanticCaveat: Exact witness text/URL/hash agreement confirms payload alignment only. It does not verify identity resolution, whether the occurrence should be included, or whether its Japanese explanation accurately interprets the text.

explicitNoQuoteExclusion.treatment: separate explicit exclusion; not transformed into quotation evidence
